BiblicalUsage: Migdal-gad is named once, among the cities of Judah: Zenan, Hadashah and Migdal-gad. It is a town in the lowland, the tower of Gad, and its name is the whole of what Scripture tells us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lowland towns count as much as the great cities: Migdal-gad stands in Judah's inheritance, and God gave the tower with the rest.
